rule.name: MSC50-CPP
rule.description: Do not use std::rand() for generating pseudorandom numbers.

rule.name: MSC51-CPP
rule.description: Ensure your random number generator is properly seeded.

rule.name: MSC52-CPP
rule.description: Value-returning functions must return a value from all exit paths.

rule.name: MSC53-CPP
rule.description: Do not return from a function declared.

rule.name: MSC54-CPP
rule.description: A signal handler must be a plain old function.

rule.name: PRE30-CPP
rule.description: Do not create a universal character name through concatenation.

rule.name: PRE31-CPP
rule.description: Avoid side effects in arguments to unsafe macros.

rule.name: PRE32-CPP
rule.description: Do not use preprocessor directives in invocations of function-like macros.

rule.name: SIG31-CPP
rule.description: Do not access shared objects in signal handlers.

rule.name: SIG34-CPP
rule.description: Do not call signal() from within interruptible signal handlers.

rule.name: SIG35-CPP
rule.description: Do not return from a computational exception signal handler.
